verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a terminal coding agent. It installs with a one-line curl script and runs as a fullscreen interactive TUI, with a headless mode for scripts. Its own sandbox, sessions and worktrees operate on the local repo. Hands-on users praise the TUI as 'butter smooth' and 'great in the ways that matter', and one ran the binary on Windows. missing for 10: access is gated behind a higher-tier subscription (one user could not get past the interactive prompt on a $40/month plan), so not every developer can run it end to end.
